human_reset: User confirmed no manual power cycle or reset during earlier failures
changes: Restore 4096x32 input asynchronous FIFO from distributed RAM to block RAM, preserving depth/interface/FWFT semantics
Retain shared 48-bit PSD with 2560x62-bit deferred queue and unchanged 2127-cycle spectrum latency

resource_tradeoff.reason: Restore four input FIFO BRAMs to obtain verified USB-only continuous operation while tightening logic/register limits

conclusion: The repaired image passed full 1048576-point RTL numerical regression, 79 finite board cases with 80896 exact snapshots, 1000 switches and 60/300 s continuous DMA under USB-only supply. No new POR was observed through the final reset-marker read. A unique electrical root cause is not proven.
causal_limits: Storage mapping, placement/routing and switching activity changed together; a unique electrical root cause has not been established
Historical failures include both new POR events and DMA errors without POR; do not label every failure a confirmed USB brownout
XADC averaged ~200 ms samples and nominal IMON conversion do not resolve transient supply droops or peak current
The successful PSD-only control and final combination do not prove that all distributed FIFO implementations are defective
